Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) shows a distinct, contrast-enhancing pseudoaneurysm located in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, which corresponds anatomically to the right middle lobe. Its position is peripheral (lateral) rather than medial, and it is situated inferior to the horizontal fissure, making mild displacement or compression of the adjacent right lower lobe bronchus the most accurate description among the choices.
